name: @qu/content-ui
description: Quniverse V4's ContentEditor layer (see docs/v4-concept.md §5): mountContentEditor() (the smallest reusable editor primitive - a textarea, submit, and an extension slot), mountContentComposer() (wraps a ContentEditor for a posting context, producing @qu/services' createContent()-shaped Content on submit), and the first real EditorExtensions (emojiExtension/mentionExtension), thin adapters over @qu/thread-ui's existing, already-proven composer primitives - not reimplementations. No Custom Elements (unlike @qu/ui) - plain functions returning/mutating real DOM, same small-composable-pieces philosophy @qu/thread-ui already follows. Browser-only.
